objective: Test, verify, improve and optimize the SHA-256 blockchain implementation under Master Harness Prompt v2.

pass_conditions.statement: sha256() reproduces the published NIST FIPS 180-4 test vectors.
sha256() agrees byte-for-byte with hashlib.sha256 across padding boundaries and randomized inputs.
Branch coverage is at least 95 percent for every module in src/.
The test suite detects every seeded mutant; zero mutants survive.
A block whose difficulty_target is forged below the chain policy is rejected by validate_chain().
Optimization changes speed only: all frozen digests remain byte-identical.
Mining throughput is at least 2x the measured baseline of ~2400 nonces/sec.

forbidden: force-push or history rewrite on any branch
changing the Merkle hex-string/single-SHA algorithm (documented deviation, I-8)

requires_operator_approval: any irreversible action not listed above
